requirements.text: The system must support the automated creation, amendment, and deletion of ISINs for money market instruments using SWIFT ISO15022 MT598 user-defined messages.
The system must use the ISIN prefix 'ZAM' to distinguish money market instruments from equities and bonds.

The system must support nine specific SWIFT message types for ISIN lifecycle management: Request New, Reject New, Accept New, Request Cancellation, Reject Cancellation, Accept Cancellation, Request Deregistration, Reject Deregistration, and Accept Deregistration.
The system must validate incoming SWIFT messages for format (MT598-901) and content (MT598-902) and issue appropriate rejection messages.
The system must provide a front-end interface for manual ISIN entry during BCP events, manual issuer code updates, and viewing/printing of issued, cancelled, and matured ISINs.
The system must provide real-time email notifications to Clearing & Settlement staff upon the occurrence of a message rejection.
The system must support parameter-driven reporting for active, cancelled, and de-registered ISINs, including filtering by issuer, instrument category, and date ranges.
The system must be capable of handling an estimated issuance volume of 200 to 500 ISINs per day.
The system must use a specific branch code 'ISN' as an extension of the JSE's current BIC address (XJSEZAJJXISN) to ensure correct routing and message identification.
The JSE and STRATE must establish a Service Level Agreement (SLA) that includes a Business Continuity Plan (BCP) for the ISIN issuance service.
The system must comply with ANNA and ISO 6166 rules and guidelines for the issuance and deletion of ISINs.
